evals.name: review-claude-subagents
evals.prompt: My team lead wants to know whether the improvement round I did on the test-checklist-generator skill on 19 September was done well, and how I did it. Write the how-did-you-do-that report for c:/projects/skills/test-checklist-generator, only session 22d20d09, and save it as report.md in the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: One report.md with the fixed 12-section structure that passes render_report.py --check. It covers only session 22d20d09, counts tokens once per API message, includes the sub-agent usage as its own rows, states the cost basis, and rates the six review criteria with evidence.
assertions: report.md exists in the outputs folder
render_report.py --check passes on report.md (all 12 sections in order, no unfilled slots)
The original prompt of session 22d20d09 is quoted word for word
The token table has a sub-agent row
The total output tokens in the report match the extractor's deduplicated total (within 2%)
The cost has a stated basis (reported by the tool, or an estimate with a source)
All six review criteria carry a rating (Good, Partly, Poor or Can't tell)
Only one session is covered
No report or metrics files were written into the target project folder

evals.name: replicate-codex-session
evals.prompt: I want to redo what Codex did in C:\projects\VS_prj\SkillRework on the morning of 27 September (the telemetry hooks session, rollout-2026-09-27T09-10-45) on my work laptop. Give me the full how-did-you-do-that write-up with everything I'd need to replicate it, only that Codex session. Save it as report.md in the outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: One report.md that passes the check and is built from the Codex log of that session: model, effort, approval policy and sandbox in the setup, a replication checklist, numbered steps and a one-shot prompt in a fenced block, and a cost estimate with a cited pricing source and date.
assertions: report.md exists in the outputs folder
render_report.py --check passes on report.md
The report names Codex as the tool and gpt-5.5 as the model
The setup states the reasoning effort and the approval policy or sandbox
The replicate section has a checklist and a one-shot prompt in a fenced block
The cost is an estimate that cites a pricing source and a date
Only one session is covered

evals.name: ask-scope-first
evals.prompt: explain to my colleague how I built the test-checklist-generator skill with AI (c:/projects/skills/test-checklist-generator)
evals.expected_output: Because the folder holds several sessions and the user named neither the sessions nor a save location, the skill lists the sessions and asks which ones to cover and where to save the report (suggesting the project root), instead of writing a report straight away.
assertions: A question for the user was produced instead of a report
The question lists at least two of the sessions found
The question offers the selection options (sessions, period, latest, all)
The question asks where to save the report and suggests the project root
